appOnly.eyebrow: FUELING AT A STATION · BENZEEN APP
appOnly.title: Paying at the pump —
appOnly.lede: Paying right at the pump works in the Benzeen mobile app. That is by design: at the pump your phone has to recognise which one you are at and finish the payment even with the screen locked. A browser cannot do that.
appOnly.pointBle: The app hears the beacon on the pump and identifies its number on its own — nothing to type in.
appOnly.pointPay: A full-tank amount is held on your card, then only the litres actually dispensed are charged. The difference comes back at once.
appOnly.pointPush: A “you are at pump #X” push arrives as you pull up, and confirming takes one tap.
appOnly.soon: The app ships together with the first connected stations. As soon as it opens, the link will appear here and arrive by SMS.
